name: Value passes through; Log reports done
nothing before a value; Log with no message still reports done; null passes through as null
because: log.ts :142 — a missing message is '', :159-160 no other outcome

name: an unknown Level falls back to info at write time (an effect, not a wire event — NSP-007; `effectiveLevel`); Log still reports done
two Log pulses in one frame are two dones
because: log.ts :135-146 — one write, one outcome, per pulse

name: a number after a unit object on Value is passed through as sent: 2, not { value: 2, unit: 'px' } (ISL-026, C6)
because: was NSP-011 §6 C6 (R7): node.ts setInputValue merged a later value into a unit object on ANY port; since ISL-026 only a port whose type declares units merges
